services.car.title: Car Detailing
services.car.subtitle: Professional Mobile Spa (Dry Cleaning)
services.car.marketingDesc: Treat your vehicle to a premium spa experience without leaving your home. Our mobile car detailing service features professional "Dry Cleaning" (limpieza en seco) techniques, providing high-end interior deep cleaning and exterior restoration using certified B Corp waterless and eco-friendly products. From stain removal and Alcantara treatment to ceramic coating protection, we ensure your car looks and feels like new with minimal environmental impact. We specialize in waterless technologies, making it a completely hassle-free experience in Zurich and Schaffhausen.

services.gardening.title: Gardening
services.gardening.desc: Expert garden maintenance, lawn care, and landscaping services for all seasons.
services.gardening.marketingDesc: Our gardening team combines horticultural expertise with precision equipment to transform and maintain your outdoor spaces. From seasonal planting and precision hedge sculpting to organic fertilization and lawn revitalization, we handle it all. We focus on biodiversity and sustainable practices, ensuring your garden remains a healthy, vibrant sanctuary in harmony with the Swiss environment.
services.gardening.size.s.desc: Lawn mowing and basic blowing included.
services.gardening.waste.desc: Mandatory if no local bio bin available.
services.exterior.title: Exterior Cleaning
services.exterior.desc: Professional pressure washing and facade restoration to keep your property looking new.
services.exterior.marketingDesc: Preserve the structural integrity and aesthetic value of your property with our industrial-grade exterior cleaning. We use specialized high-pressure and soft-wash techniques tailored to various materials including natural stone, concrete, wood decking, and modern facades. Our process effectively removes years of atmospheric pollutants, moss, and algae, using eco-safe detergents that protect both your building and the surrounding ecosystem.
services.exterior.material.wood.desc: Requires low pressure and nourishing products.
services.pest.title: Pest Control
services.pest.desc: Professional, safe, and discreet solutions for all types of pest issues.
services.pest.marketingDesc: Kraken provides rapid and discreet intervention for pest management in residential and commercial properties. We utilize modern, low-impact integrated pest management (IPM) strategies that prioritize non-toxic barriers and preventive monitoring over heavy chemical use. Whether it is seasonal insect control or emergency rodent management, our certified technicians ensure a safe, hygienic, and compliant environment for you and your tenants.
services.waste.title: Waste Management
services.waste.desc: Eco-friendly disposal, clearance, and recycling services for homes and offices.
services.waste.marketingDesc: We take the burden out of waste removal with our comprehensive sorting and disposal service. Kraken specializes in responsible site clearances, handling everything from general household items to electronic waste (WEEE) and heavy furniture. We adhere to the highest Swiss recycling standards, ensuring that every load is properly sorted and delivered to certified regional processing facilities to minimize landfill impact.
services.gutter.title: Gutter Cleaning
services.gutter.desc: Essential maintenance to prevent water damage and ensure proper drainage.
services.gutter.marketingDesc: Neglected gutters are a primary cause of structural water damage and foundation issues. Our gutter maintenance service uses high-reach vacuum systems and inspection cameras to thoroughly clear debris and ensure optimal drainage performance. We don't just clean; we inspect for blockages, leaks, and pitch issues, providing you with a documented status report and peace of mind during the heavy Swiss rains.
services.upholstery.title: Upholstery Cleaning
services.upholstery.desc: Deep-cleaning and restoration for all fabric and leather furniture.
services.upholstery.marketingDesc: Revitalize your furniture with our professional upholstery cleaning service. We treat sofas, armchairs, carpets, and mattresses using deep steam extraction or specialized dry compound cleaning suited to each fiber type. Our eco-friendly formulas remove embedded dust, grease, allergens, and tough stains without leaving sticky residues, ensuring a healthier and more inviting home.
services.window.title: Window Cleaning
services.window.desc: Streak-free window, frame, and glass cleaning for brilliant clarity.
services.window.marketingDesc: Enjoy pristine views with our high-end window cleaning service. Our experienced team uses advanced osmotized (pure) water technology and specialized squeegees to clean not only the glass but also the frames, sills, and shutters. We guarantee streak-free clarity for hard-to-reach residential and light commercial windows, preserving the long-term beauty of your glass.
services.mudanzaCajas.title: Packing & Boxes Service
services.mudanzaCajas.desc: Stress-free packing and organized moving boxes preparation.
services.mudanzaCajas.marketingDesc: Minimize relocation stress with our premium packing and box preparation service. We provide sturdy, high-quality moving boxes, protective bubble wrap, and structural packing materials. Our specialists carefully wrap, catalog, and secure fragile items, kitchenware, and books, making sure everything is perfectly organized and ready for transport.
services.pulidoSuelos.title: Floor Polishing
services.pulidoSuelos.desc: Restoration, sealing, and high-shine polishing for all premium flooring.
services.pulidoSuelos.marketingDesc: Bring back the original luster of your floors with our custom polishing and sealing treatment. We handle parquet wood, marble, terrazzo, and high-end linoleum using professional buffer machines and premium, long-lasting finishing products. Our treatment seals porous surfaces against wear and moisture, restoring a vibrant, glossy finish that lasts.
services.restaurant.title: Bar & Restaurant Cleaning
services.restaurant.desc: Specialized deep cleaning and sanitization for kitchens, dining areas, and bars.
services.restaurant.marketingDesc: Ensure pristine hygiene and health code compliance with our professional gastronomy, bar, and restaurant cleaning services.

services.title: Our Services
services.endOfTenancy.title: End of Tenancy Cleaning
services.endOfTenancy.marketingDesc: We guarantee the full return of your deposit with our certified end-of-tenancy cleaning. We meticulously handle every corner of your home, from the inside of built-in appliances to windows, blinds, and specialized surfaces, ensuring the strictest standards required by property administrations in Zurich and Schaffhausen. For your convenience, we accept requests even with 48 hours notice. Once the work is completed, our management team conducts a thorough and documented quality control check, ensuring a stress-free transition and the full return of your security deposit.
services.deepCleaning.title: Deep Cleaning
services.deepCleaning.marketingDesc: Revitalize and refresh any space with our intensive deep cleaning service. It is the ideal option for seasonal renewals or for preparing a property for new occupants. We use professional equipment and techniques to tackle accumulated dirt, thoroughly descale kitchens and bathrooms, intensively clean grout, and treating specialized floors and upholstery. This service guarantees to bring your property to an exceptionally high level of hygiene and presentation, exceeding the requirements of a standard cleaning.
services.dailyCleaning.title: Daily/Recurring Cleaning
services.dailyCleaning.marketingDesc: Reliable and consistent cleaning maintenance for offices and residential properties. Our daily or weekly service ensures a continuously impeccable environment. We operate with full transparency and compliance with Swiss legislation: our staff is fully insured, and all mandatory social benefits (GAV, AHV, BVG) are included in our rate, offering you peace of mind and an ethical, consistent, and high-quality service.
services.movingFurniture.title: Furniture Moving
services.movingFurniture.marketingDesc: Professional assistance for the safe movement and relocation of your furniture. Our team of experienced operators handles careful packing, loading, transportation, and efficient unloading at your new location, using specialized vehicles and equipment. We offer clear hourly rates based on the number of staff required, ensuring transparency and efficiency in time management. Our service includes comprehensive insurance coverage for all transported items.
services.propertyMaintenance.title: Property Maintenance
services.propertyMaintenance.marketingDe: Preventive and corrective solutions to keep your properties in optimal condition. We offer a rapid response service for any issue, from minor repairs to complex technical emergencies. We have a specialized in-house team capable of resolving critical problems such as gas leaks, electrical failures, plumbing issues, and professional rodent and pest control. We offer the efficiency of a single point of contact for all the technical needs of your home or building, avoiding the costly fees of external specialists.
services.propertyManagement.title: Property Management
services.propertyManagement.marketingDes: Comprehensive and complete management of your real estate investment, handling the process from tenant search and contract management to financial administration and technical maintenance. Our service guarantees the optimization of your income and the peace mind of legal compliance. For total transparency and smooth communication, we are developing a web portal and a mobile application that will allow owners and tenants to access all property information, documents, and maintenance status in real time.

about.title: Who We Are: Your Facility Partner in Zurich & Schaffhausen
about.p1: At Kraken, we redefine property and facilities management through precision, innovation, and trust. We provide a comprehensive property management service for clients who value reliability, transparency, and performance. From tenant sourcing and screening to furnishing, utilities, and ongoing maintenance, we handle every detail—so property owners can enjoy effortless management while maximizing their investment.
about.p2: With over 11 years of industry experience in London and Switzerland, including work with prestigious names such as Mandarin Savoy, Hotel Ambassador, Opera, and Hotel Five, we bring a hospitality-level standard of care to the property sector. At Kraken, we merge hands-on expertise with technology-driven systems to deliver order where others find complexity.
about.image_alt: Kraken Properties team providing professional facility management services
aboutPage.storyTitle: The Legend of Kai: Order from the Abyss
aboutPage.storyP1: In the crystal-clear waters of the Rhine, where the falls of Schaffhausen roar with an energy that bridges history and engineering, a different kind of legend was born. For centuries, sailors of the North feared the Kraken—a symbol of chaos that dragged even the strongest ships into the dark deep. But in the heart of Switzerland, a beautiful antithesis emerged from the current.
aboutPage.storyP2: Kai was not born to destroy, but to untangle. Where others see the overwhelming chaos of property maintenance, the heavy storms of logistics, or the deep pressure of multi-asset management, Kai finds harmony. He is the guardian of architectural order, using his many tentacles not to pull down, but to lift up, organize, and meticulously calibrate every detail of your environment.
aboutPage.storyP3: From his first breath in the Rhine, Kai has been here to offer help across all functions of facilities management. He understands the intricate plumbing of a building with the same natural precision as the flow of the river. He is the quiet force that ensures everything operates with Swiss excellence, even when the world outside feels like an ocean of complexity and noise.
aboutPage.storyP4: Today, our Kraken is still small, but his vision is vast and his reach is growing every single day. We invite you to be part of his evolution. By working together, you are not just hiring a service; you are helping Kai grow, expanding his tentacles across the Swiss plateau to bring the "Kraken Standard" of perfection to every home and office. Let’s build this legacy of order together, one property at a time.
aboutPage.comic.panel1: WHILE THE WORLD FEARS THE NORDIC KRAKEN, A DIFFERENT LEGEND WAS BORN IN SCHAFFHAUSEN. KAI TRAINS TO BRING ORDER TO CHAOS.
aboutPage.comic.panel2: WHERE OTHERS SEE CHAOS, KAI USES HIS 8 TENTACLES TO FIND FAST SOLUTIONS AND UNTANGLE LOGISTICAL PROBLEMS.
aboutPage.comic.panel3: THE SWISS EXCELLENCE IN EVERY DETAIL. KAI APPLIES THE 'KRAKEN STANDARD': MILLIMETRIC PRECISION FOR IMPECCABLE RESULTS.
aboutPage.comic.panel4: GROWING TOGETHER TO BUILD A FUTURE OF ORDER AND SUCCESS IN THE HEART OF SCHAFFHAUSEN.

gdpr.title: Privacy Policy & GDPR/nFADP Compliance
gdpr.intro.title: Introduction
gdpr.intro.p1: At Kraken Properties and Facilities Management ("Kraken"), we take your privacy seriously. This policy explains how we process personal data in accordance with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (nFADP) and the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
gdpr.collect.title: Data We Collect & Purpose
gdpr.collect.p1: We collect data to provide professional property services. This includes:
gdpr.collect.item1: Identification Data: Name, address, email, and phone number (for service execution).
gdpr.collect.item2: Property Data: Photos, videos, and square footage (for accurate quoting and validation).
gdpr.collect.item3: Financial Data: We use PCI-DSS compliant third-party processors. Kraken does not store full credit card numbers on its own servers.
gdpr.collect.item4: Technical Data: IP addresses and cookies (for website optimization).
gdpr.basis.title: Legal Basis for Processing
gdpr.basis.p1: We process your data based on:
gdpr.basis.item1: Contractual Necessity: To provide the quotes and services you requested.
gdpr.basis.item2: Legal Obligation: For tax and accounting purposes in Switzerland.
gdpr.basis.item3: Legitimate Interest: To improve our service quality and ensure property security.
gdpr.retention.title: Data Retention & Third Parties
gdpr.retention.storage: Storage: Data is stored on secure servers, prioritizing Swiss or European locations.
gdpr.retention.sharing: Sharing: We only share data with "Specialized Partners" (e.g., a plumber assigned to your job) or cloud service providers. We never sell your data.
gdpr.retention.time: Retention: We keep client data for the duration of the business relationship and for 10 years thereafter (Swiss statutory requirement for accounting records).
gdpr.rights.title: Your Rights
gdpr.rights.p1: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your data. You may also withdraw consent for marketing at any time. To exercise these rights, contact kai@krakenpfm.ch.
gdpr.disclaimer.main.title: Legal Disclaimer & Intellectual Property
gdpr.disclaimer.estimates.title: Accuracy of Estimates
gdpr.disclaimer.estimates.p1: The "Smart Booking" calculator provides non-binding estimates. A binding contract is only formed upon written confirmation and/or the provision of media (photos/videos) as per our T&Cs. Kraken reserves the right to adjust pricing based on actual on-site conditions.
gdpr.disclaimer.liability.title: Limitation of Liability
gdpr.disclaimer.liability.p1: While Kraken maintains a CHF 10 Million Liability Insurance, our digital liability is limited. We are not responsible for technical errors on the booking platform, damage caused by external links, or inaccurate information provided by the client.
gdpr.disclaimer.ip.title: Intellectual Property (IP)
gdpr.disclaimer.ip.p1: All content, including the Kraken mascot, logo, and "Smart Booking" logic, is the exclusive property of Kraken Properties and Facilities Management.
gdpr.disclaimer.ip.usage: Usage: You may not copy, reproduce, or "frame" our website content for commercial purposes without written consent.
gdpr.disclaimer.ip.trademarks: Trademarks: The name "Kraken" and its associated visual brand are protected under Swiss Trademark Law.

blog.art1.title: End-of-Tenancy Cleaning in Zurich: Succeeding in Swiss Handover Inspections
blog.art1.excerpt: Passing a property inspection in Switzerland is notoriously demanding. Learn the rigorous cleaning standards and legal guidelines required to get your full security deposit back.
blog.art1.p1: Moving out of a Swiss apartment comes with an infamous architectural milestone: the handover inspection (Wohnungsabgabe). In Switzerland, rental properties must be returned in close-to-immaculate condition, surpassing what many countries consider "deeply cleaned". Landlords or agencies inspect every millimeter with extreme attention to detail.
blog.art1.p2: Common failure points during these handovers include lime-scale buildup in bathroom faucets, greasy ventilation filters in the kitchen, and overlooked storage rooms or cellars (Estrich/Keller). Utilizing a specialized cleaning service like Kraken—which offers a "Handover Guarantee" (Abgabegarantie)—ensures our deep-cleaning team is present to rectify any direct feedback from the inspector.
blog.art1.p3: To succeed yourself, create a rigid checklist: descale all wet areas using professional-grade agents, clean window panes inside and out including the frames and blinds (Storen), vacuum and steam-clean parquet or carpeted floors, and ensure all wall plugs and woodwork are free of scuffs. Properly prepping saves thousands of Swiss Francs and ensures peace of mind.
blog.art2.title: Alpine Solar Care: Elevating Output with Mountain Efficiency
blog.art2.excerpt: Solar panels in Switzerland are exposed to unique high-altitude mountain pollen, industrial dust, and winter atmospheric soot. Discover why specialized pure-water washing is vital.
blog.art2.p1: Switzerland leads in clean energy integration, with thousands of photovoltaic installations gracing rooftops from Schaffhausen down to alpine valleys. However, many owners do not realize that dirt, bird droppings, Sahara dust, and pine pollen can degrade solar efficiency by up to 20% in a single season. The standard rain is rarely sufficient to clear this film.
blog.art2.p2: Cleaning solar facilities is a delicate technical procedure. Traditional tap-water leaves mineral deposits (calcification) which can create micro-shades, heating up cells and permanently damaging them. Professional care requires demineralized pure water applied with soft, non-abrasive rotating brushes, avoiding any weight load on the delicate panels.
blog.art2.p3: By performing regular solar maintenance, you protect your long-term capital investment and maximize the feed-in tariffs returned to the grid. In Switzerland, doing this twice a year—conceptually after the heavy spring pollen and preceding the first winter snowfall—maintains optimal performance and extends the lifespan of the system.
blog.art3.title: AI & Data-Driven Facility Care: Redefining Swiss Workspaces
blog.art3.excerpt: How IoT environmental sensors, smart scheduling, and centralized analytics are transforming workspace productivity and energy efficiency in modern Swiss offices.
blog.art3.p1: Modern business infrastructure in Swiss hubs like Zurich, Winterthur, and Geneva is undergoing a massive digital overhaul. Traditional facility services rely on rigid, pre-set schedules (e.g., cleaning every desk at 18:00 daily). Today, smart buildings utilize active IoT sensors to trigger demand-based, responsive cleaning models.
blog.art3.p2: By tracking actual room occupancy, air quality, and restroom usage, facilities teams focus energy and attention where it is truly needed. If a conference hall has been empty all day, the system automatically redirects technicians to high-traffic collaboration zones, optimizing workspace hygiene and operational efficiency.
blog.art3.p3: In addition, centralized management allows business clients to monitor energy consumption, track technical service response times, and reduce corporate carbon footprints. Integrating smart tech is no longer just a luxury—it is the baseline for sustainable, highly productive commercial environments.
